Name: FS - Wardrobe of Octopath Traveler
Author: ease1219
Description:
[center][size=5]🐙2024.7.13 is the 6th anniversary of Octopath Traveler! 🎈
[/size]歧路旅人的六周年纪念日即将到来！[/center]
[size=3]To celebrate, I'm happy to release the beta version of my Octopath Traveler appearance mod (based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]), which could let you cosplay the characters in Octopath Traveler! [/size]
[size=2]为了庆祝，我很高兴地宣布，在这里上传我制作的基于Fashion Sense的歧路旅人外观模组！让你能够在游玩过程中cosplay歧路旅人中的角色！[/size]

[size=3]But, as it is not totally completed, I wish you could be patient for possible updates! 🙏[/size]
[size=2]但是，它还是半成品，所以我希望大家可以耐心等待后续可能实施的更新！[/size]

It is recommended to use following two FS mods at the same time:
使用本模组时，推荐同时使用以下两个FS模组：
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14154]Vanilla Pants and Skirts[/url]﻿：提供可染色的游戏原生裤子和裙子。
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15431]SH's Gloves and Sleeves Pack[/url]﻿：提供可染色的各种样式的手套和袖子。
[/list]
——
[size=3]If you are a fan of Octopath Traveler series, I recommend you also install my another mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25992]Wardrobe of Octopath Traveler II[/url][/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25987]
[/url]如果你是歧路旅人系列的粉丝，我推荐同时安装我歧路旅人二代的外观模组共同使用！↑
——

[size=3]Here is the list of what this mod currently contains, but attention: this is only used for you to know the contents, the language I used for the mod is Mandarin, and the real names of the clothes are not the same as below![/size]
[size=2]下面是这个模组当前包含的内容，但是请注意：这个目录仅用于让您了解模组内的内容，模组使用的语言是简体中文，并且模组内服饰的真实名字不与列表内容完全一致！[/size]

[size=4][b]Hair[/b][/size][list]
[*]欧菲莉亚（常规） Ophilia (Default)
[*]赛拉斯 Cyrus
[*]特蕾莎（无帽常规） Tressa (No hat)
[*]特蕾莎（含商人帽） Tressa (With hat)
[*](Adjusted!) 欧尔贝克 Olberic
[*]普利姆萝洁（常规） Primrose (Default)
[*]亚芬 Alfyn
[*]泰里翁 Therion
[*]海茵特（常规） H'aaint (Default)
[*]泰蕾兹 Therese
[/list]
[b][size=4]Shirt[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]欧菲莉亚神官装（无披风） Ophilia-cleric (without cape)
[*]赛拉斯学者装（无学者袍） Cyrus-scholar (without robe)
[*]特蕾莎商人装 （无背包）Tressa-merchant (without backpack)
[*]普里姆萝洁舞女装 Primrose-dancer
[*]亚芬药师装 Alfyn-apothecary 
[*]泰里翁盗贼装（无围巾） Therion-thief (without scarf)
[*]海茵特猎人装（无毛领） H'aaint-hunter (no fur collar)
[*](New!) 欧尔贝克剑士装 Olberic-warrior
[/list]
[b][size=4]Hat[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]特蕾莎商人帽 Tressa-merchant
[/list]
[b][size=4]Accessory[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]赛拉斯学者袍（顶） Cyrus-scholar robe (top)*
[*]赛拉斯学者袍（底） Cyrus-scholar robe (bottom)*
[*]欧菲莉亚神官披风 Ophilia-cleric cape
[*]欧菲莉亚神官长手套 Ophilia-cleric long gloves
[*]泰里翁盗贼围巾 Therion-thief scarf
[/list] ﻿(*学者袍两个部件应同时穿戴。The two robe accessories need to be worn at the same time.)

[size=3]And this mod gives many pre-sets, let you be able to wear as your favourite character. (But you need to prepare dress, skirts and trousers by yourself.)[/size]
同时，本mod提供了多个预设套装，让你可以更方便的一键打扮成心仪角色的样子。（但是裙子、裤子等下装需要自行搭配）



[size=3][b]Special thanks towards my friends![/b][/size]
特别感谢朋友们的支持！（朝原若海、阿鲁、雨月幻彩等）
